description: Before an agent pays: can this Base or Solana wallet pay a given USDC amount? Returns ETH/SOL and USDC balances, canPay for x402 (gasless for the payer) and for a direct transfer, shortfalls, USDC blacklist / frozen-account flags, wallet type (EOA, smart contract, EIP-7702) and open token approvals to well-known spenders (Base routers, Permit2, bridges) or SPL delegates (Solana), with an ok / review / cannot_pay status. Read live from public RPC. Read-only, never places orders. Informational only, not investment advice.
